Passes were sold BEFORE any band was announced. Remaining routes: official resale on tickets.hellfest.fr (opened 8 Jul 2026), and 1-day passes in Q1 2027 (also expected to go fast). price_notes: 2026 4-day ticket about €194 in presale (festivalhopper); day tickets €90 (no campsite access). 2027 early-booking ticket €199 in the official shop (festivalhopper), now sold out. Standard camping is included with the 4-day ticket. Extras are paid: Campground R power pitches, Caravan Park, pre-pitched tent ('Mein Zelt steht schon'), My Molo pop-up hotel, power flatrate.

ratings.value: 2026 tickets sold out in 3 days
2026: 25,000+ fans, peaceful, camping routes and traffic concept worked well

2022.summary: Post-COVID return. No notable problems found (limited research).

2023.summary: Normal edition. No notable problems found (limited research).

2024.summary: Bruce Dickinson (his only German festival show), Judas Priest and Kreator. Sold out in about six weeks.

2025.summary: Powerwolf and Heaven Shall Burn, ~25,000 fans. Sold out in one week; little negative coverage found.

2026.summary: Helloween, Alice Cooper, Kreator and Emperor. Peaceful with 25k+ fans; camping and traffic praised; inclusion camp for 500+ disabled guests.

strengths: Camping included and cheap (~€199 all-in)
Pure metal bill with a fan-friendly vibe; two stages alternate so you can see most sets
Well run and peaceful, good accessibility programme
Strong 2027 bill (Amon Amarth, Arch Enemy, Bruce Dickinson)
ticket_ease_notes: 2024 sold out in just under six weeks. 2025 sold out within one week of the early-booking phase. 2026 sold out in three days (announced 11 July 2025). 2027 4-day tickets sold out within days of the July 2026 presale and the homepage says 'sold out'. The official resale marketplace (ticketmarktplatz.rockharz-festival.com) has a waitlist registration.
ticket_status_note: 2027 4-day festival tickets are sold out; the only route is the official resale marketplace (ticketmarktplatz.rockharz-festival.com), while camping extras went on sale 28 Oct 2026.
trend_reason: Each year sells out faster (6 weeks, then 1 week, then 3 days, then 2027 gone within days), with consistently smooth editions.
weaknesses: 2027 already sold out; only the official resale marketplace remains
Remote airfield in rural Saxony-Anhalt, hard to reach from abroad without a car
Mid-size; headliners are a tier below Wacken or Hellfest
Open airfield, so heat/weather exposure (not verified for recent editions)

camping: paid add-on: 2025 fenced BACKSTAGE Camp 500 CZK per tent + 300 CZK per person for the whole festival (~EUR 33 for one person with tent); car parking 600 CZK; separate stadium camp in Vizovice; luxury tents at 'Chill Village' for comfort.
capacity: ~20,000-25,000/day (organisers routinely quote 'more than 20,000 visitors'; Metal Insider 2025 preview: up to 25,000 guests)
genre_focus: melodic/power/heavy metal and hard rock, some symphonic; occasional extreme acts (Septicflesh, Gaerea)
lineup: Slash featuring Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators
name: Masters of Rock
price_notes: 2027 standing festival pass 3,750 CZK (~EUR 154 at ~24.3 CZK/EUR) at 'starting price', + 25 CZK processing fee per ticket. 2026 pass price not found (null); 2025 standing pass was 3,500 CZK (~EUR 139-140). VIP seated grandstand tickets (PLATINUM/GOLD/SILVER) sold separately on the official site. Camping NOT included. Children under 3 free; over 3 need full ticket.

ratings.value: very positive review of 20th anniversary edition, no numeric score

2024.summary: 20th-anniversary edition praised (Bruce Dickinson, Judas Priest, Avantasia, Accept); heat on Friday and a rain/wind storm briefly interrupted Judas Priest.

2025.summary: Till Lindemann, Powerwolf, Hammerfall, Apocalyptica w/ Floor Jansen; no problems reported, tickets still available at the gate.

2026.summary: Helloween 40th anniversary, Marilyn Manson, In Flames, Arch Enemy; ~20k expected, no incidents reported in coverage found.

strengths: Cheap (~EUR 150 pass) with big heritage headliners (Judas Priest, Bruce Dickinson, Slash in 2027)
Unique setting in R. Jelinek distillery grounds
Tickets easy to get, even at the gate
Seated VIP grandstand option
Single main stage format means few clashes
ticket_ease_notes: Never found to sell out in 2024-2026; in 2025 and 2026 tickets were still sold at both gate box offices during the festival. 2027 passes on sale now at early 'starting price' (tiers rise later). Sold via mastersofrock.cz, Ticketportal, Ticketstream, NFCtron.
ticket_status_note: 2027 festival passes on sale at early 'starting price' of 3,750 CZK (~EUR 154) + 25 CZK fee.
trend_reason: Stable mid-size festival with consistent heritage/power-metal headliners and ~20-25k attendance; 2027 bill (Judas Priest, Slash, Bruce Dickinson) is strong but in line with recent years.
weaknesses: Camping costs extra
Lineups skew toward repeat/heritage power-metal acts
Remote small town in Moravia (nearest big airports Vienna/Brno/Prague/Krakow)
Little English-language review coverage
Summer heat and storms

camping: free unfenced camping area (unlimited); paid add-ons: Abono Acampada EUR 5 + fees (EUR 8 at gate), Acampada Sombra (shaded) EUR 15 + fees (sold out in 2026); separate paid pool area.
capacity: ~15,000+/day (2026 organisers expected 'more than 15,000 spectators'); ~50,000 total attendance in 2023
genre_focus: heavy/power/classic metal with modern metalcore and Spanish-language metal; ~90% metal
name: Leyendas del Rock
price_notes: 2026 general abono EUR 189 (La Ganzua listing); 2025 abono from EUR 168. 2027 'XXI edicion' abonos are on sale via Enterticket but price was not visible in fetched pages (aggregator festt.io had no 2027 price). Camping and pool area are separate passes. Prices in EUR.

2023.summary: ~50,000 attendees, Megadeth; organisers improved toilets, water points, cleaning and heat misting; no significant incidents.

2024.summary: Promoter called it 'the best edition ever' (Amon Amarth, Electric Callboy); council reported no incidents.

2025.summary: Powerwolf, Within Temptation, W.A.S.P., Heilung; no notable complaints found (limited coverage).

2026.summary: 20th anniversary: Helloween, In Flames, Arch Enemy, Savatage, Sepultura farewell; added stages, doubled bleachers, Alicante shuttles.

strengths: Cheap (~EUR 170-190 pass, near-free camping)
Strong heavy/power-metal headliners; Mercyful Fate exclusive-style booking for 2027
Tickets easy to get
Reliable August sun, pool area
Short trip from Alicante airport
ticket_ease_notes: Full abonos have not been reported as selling out; 2026 pre-sales pointed to full days but tickets remained purchasable. Shaded camping sold out in 2026. 2027 abonos already on sale (Enterticket; also Ticketmaster/Fnac per site).
ticket_status_note: 2027 (XXI edition) abonos are on sale via Enterticket; price not visible in fetched pages.
trend_reason: Steady growth with infrastructure upgrades and increasingly big bills; 2027 already has Mercyful Fate's first show in 3+ years plus Architects, Halestorm, Saxon.
weaknesses: Extreme August heat in an inland sports-ground venue
Smaller scale (~15k/day)
Limited English-language coverage/reviews
Shaded camping sells out

camping: campsite next to Kerampuilh site, open from the day before, showers/toilets/water, reserved for valid ticket holders (aggregator wording implies included; not confirmed on official site). Reviewers noted stony ground in parts. VIP pass available, no glamping info found.
capacity: up to ~15,000/day site capacity; 62,500 total visits in 2025 (record, +15% vs 2024); ~54,000 in 2023 and 2024
genre_focus: eclectic heavy music: extreme metal, metalcore/deathcore, stoner/doom, post-rock, plus some offbeat/French acts
name: Motocultor
price_notes: 2027 4-day pass (Fever): Early Bird 1 EUR 198 (sold out), EB2 EUR 218 (sold out), EB3 EUR 228 (on sale), Regular EUR 239; official site says prices exclude booking fees. Day passes 'coming soon'. 2026: 4-day from EUR 217 presale, VIP 4-day EUR 270, day EUR 77.50 (per festivalenfrance.com aggregator, not verified on official site).

ratings.value: positive on lineup/human scale; critical of dust, shade, security

2023.summary: First edition at Carhaix (Vieilles Charrues site), record ~54k attendance but ran at a financial loss.

2024.summary: ~54k attendance, director called it a clear success with good sound; cost pressures noted.

2025.summary: Record 62,500 (+15%): praised lineup and human scale; complaints about dust, no shade in 30C+ heat, stony camping, overwhelmed security.

strengths: Very diverse, deep bill (110+ bands, 4 stages)
Human scale, friendly atmosphere
Mid-range price (~EUR 200-240)
Growing attendance and bigger headliners
ticket_ease_notes: Not a fast sell-out: 2025 Sunday (Machine Head) was nearly sold out days before, other days later; passes remained available. For 2027 Early Bird 1 and 2 already sold out, EB3 on sale, Regular next. Official ticketing via Fever.
ticket_status_note: 2027 4-day passes on sale at Early Bird 3 (EUR 228 excl. fees); EB1/EB2 sold out, Regular EUR 239 next; day passes not yet on sale.
trend_reason: Attendance has grown each year since moving to Carhaix (54k -> 62.5k) and bookings keep getting bigger (Helloween, Halestorm, The HU for 2027), though finances were shaky in 2023.
weaknesses: Organisation 'rough around the edges' (security, dust, little shade, dark corners)
Remote inland Brittany (nearest airports Brest/Rennes/Nantes)
Headliners smaller than the big festivals
Financial fragility (2023 loss)
